item.title: Simon Zwa
item.description: Simon is a self-taught DJ with a deep passion for organic, progressive, afro and deep house music. His musical tastes are broad and eclectic, shaped by a lifelong connection to sound that spans punk, new wave, ska, alternative rock, industrial, classical, and a wide spectrum of electronic music.

item.title: Matt Allgood
item.description: Matt fell in love with Hip-hop in the late 80s and early 90s—drawn in by scratching and breakbeats—and began DJing on borrowed decks while collecting the Hip-hop, House and Hardcore of the era. In 1994 he finally got his own 1210s (still going strong today) and started playing parties and bars around Windsor, Maidenhead and Marlow, including a three-year Friday night residency in Marlow called Café del Marlow.
